## Summary

Describe the focused change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior.
- [ ] `R CMD check --no-manual` passes locally.
- [ ] User-facing documentation and `NEWS.md` are updated when needed.
- [ ] All examples, fixtures, logs, and screenshots use synthetic or openly
      licensed public data.
- [ ] No confidential, restricted, unpublished, personally identifying, or
      credential material is included.
